title: Registry entity
description: Canonical entity for the ro-edu-registry. Every entity in data/entities/*.json must validate against this schema.

parent.description: Id of the parent entity (e.g. the university a faculty belongs to, or the host school of a robotics club). Optional; omit for top-level entities.

city.description: City or commune. Populated for manually added entities; schools carry the full address in addr instead.

env.description: URBAN / RURAL. Populated from the admitere feed for schools; null otherwise.

coords.description: [lon, lat] in WGS84, or null until geocoded.

coords_precision.description: How coords were obtained, best to coarsest: building = exact OpenStreetMap object (school building/POI); address = geocoded from the entity's name/address (the default when this field is absent); locality = center of the locality (village/city); area = centroid of a larger OpenStreetMap area polygon (e.g. campus), or a shared fallback point — least precise.

external_ids.description: Identifiers in external programs/systems, e.g. {"ftc": 32744} for a FIRST Tech Challenge team number. Keys are lowercase program slugs (ftc, fll, frc, vex, …).

stats.description: Admission counts from admitere.edu.ro. null = unit absent from the stats feed (no 8th-grade cohort in this repartizare cycle), distinct from a real 0.

source.description: Provenance of this link, e.g. openstreetmap, manual, the institution's own site.
Provenance of the entity data: the origin domain (admitere.edu.ro, upb.ro, …), openstreetmap (harvested from OpenStreetMap tags), or manual (added/corrected by a person).

added_by.description: GitHub username of the person who added or corrected this entity (credit; the authoritative record is git history).
